description: This file contains unit tests for the functions 'buildEmbeddedCompactionRuntimeContext' and 'resolveEmbeddedCompactionTarget'. It tests various scenarios including the normalization of fields, application of configuration overrides, and default behaviors related to embedded compaction runtime context construction.

methods.name: buildEmbeddedCompactionRuntimeContext
methods.description: Creates a runtime context object for embedded compaction based on input parameters and configuration overrides.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddedCompactionTarget
methods.description: Determines the effective provider and model for the compaction target, applying defaults and overrides.
